headline: The AI that stands beside your family at every insurance moment.
subhead: Kavach remembers your family's cover and acts when it matters: when life changes, at the hospital desk, and when a claim goes wrong.
tryHospitalSub: Sample estimate, Hindi or English, under a minute. No sign-in.
previewCaption: What Kavach tells the family at the hospital desk

change.title: When life changes
change.body: “Joining a startup on 1 Dec.” Kavach sees that your parents’ cover ends on 30 Nov, drafts the letter to keep it, and reminds you on WhatsApp.

hospital.title: At the hospital desk
hospital.body: Voice and camera, in Hindi. Show the estimate and Kavach says which policy card to give and which room to ask for.

claim.title: When a claim goes wrong
claim.body: Send the settlement letter. Kavach checks every deduction against your policy and drafts the appeal.

whatsapp.title: No app? Same answer on WhatsApp
whatsapp.body: Send a photo of the estimate or a Hindi voice note. Kavach replies with a voice note and a card.
whatsapp.qrAlt: QR code that opens WhatsApp with the message to join Kavach’s test number
whatsapp.notConfigured: The WhatsApp test number isn’t set up yet.
whatsapp.step1: Scan the code with your phone camera. WhatsApp opens with a join message.
whatsapp.step2: Send that message to join Kavach’s test number.
whatsapp.step3: Send RAHUL to get the family alert on your phone, then send a photo of an estimate or a voice note.
whatsapp.note: This uses a WhatsApp test number. Membership lasts 3 days; scan again after that.

trust.title: Every number shows its working
trust.body: Rupee amounts come from tested rules, never from a guess. Tap “Why these numbers?” to see the rule and the clause behind each one.

footer.disclaimer: Guidance, not a policy recommendation. Confirm with your insurer or the TPA desk.
footer.sample: Everything in this demo is made-up sample data.
footer.built: Built on Gemini and Google Cloud.

eyebrow: Hindi and English · voice first · built for the whole family
statsLabel: What Kavach has found in the sample family

stats.desk: less to pay, by asking for the right room at the hospital desk
stats.claim: found to appeal in one settlement letter

momentsIntro: Kavach learns the household once, in about two minutes. Then it acts at the three moments where Indian families lose money.
titleEm: explained at the moment it matters.
lead: Kavach remembers every policy in the house and tells you what to do when life changes, at the hospital desk, and when a claim comes back short. In Hindi or English. Every rupee comes from written policy terms, with the page number.

moment.title: The <saving></saving> moment
moment.body: Suresh is being admitted. The deluxe room costs the family about <deluxe></deluxe> out of pocket; the cheaper room about <standard></standard>. Kavach says which one, and why, before anyone signs.

trustLine: Built for the Google Cloud AI Builder Cup 2026 · Demo data is marked SAMPLE · Nothing is stored without consent · No payments, ever.
tryMaternitySub: Priya’s delivery: the ₹50,000 maternity limit, in English.
kicker: Take a breath. The policies are already read.

boot.policies: Your family’s policies: read, with page numbers
boot.beside: Standing beside you, in Hindi or English
boot.tagline: Standing beside your family at every insurance moment.

family.title: The sample family Kavach already knows
family.caption: Five people, four policies, one picture. Kavach learnt them once, in about two minutes.

relations.mother: Kamala, 58 · opens Kavach at the desk

step1.title: Kamala taps At the hospital
step1.body: In Hindi, on her own phone. Kavach already knows Suresh’s two policies.

step2.title: She shows the estimate to the camera
step2.body: Kavach reads the room tariff: deluxe ₹9,000 a day, standard ₹5,000.

step3.title: “Ask for the ₹5,000 room.”
step3.body: Only room-priced charges are cut in the pricier room. Kavach says which card to give first, and what to ask the desk.
